reviews.review:
These are my impressions after playing this game for a short time (sorry, these are somewhat harsh opinions).

Honestly, as it stands, it feels less like racing on a low-gravity planet and more like a "broken racing game" with incorrectly set car physics. I think that even if the "gravity effect" were halved, it would still be enough to give players a sense of being in an environment different from Earth, and it would also make the game easier to play. Also, in a racing game, no player enjoys watching their car crash into something, spin, and slowly float into the air; it's incredibly frustrating. Therefore, a reset position button (if one doesn't exist) is necessary to allow immediate return to the track after a crash. I thought the slow pace of the race was unique and not bad, but some people might find it increasingly boring because of its slowness.

Currently, cars lose traction and slip quite easily, turning around and facing backward. I think this kind of behavior should be reduced. The mere mention of low gravity makes controlling the car difficult, so unless the car's basic behavior is made more stable, it will become too difficult to control, causing a lot of stress rather than enjoyment for many players. Personally, I think this game should be balanced more like an arcade racing game. Even if you force simulation elements into this game, few people will understand it. Also, it seems that motorcycles and monster trucks not only have extremely slow acceleration, but their steering is almost completely ineffective (they can only really go in a straight line).

It would be best to remove out-of-place vehicles like police cars and pickup trucks. Rather than being humorous, it could lead players to think, "This game seems to be indiscriminately throwing in vehicles bought from the asset store." I think the game would feel more authentic and stand out more if it were unified with only vehicles developed to run on different planets, like the cool red six-wheeled car. If you absolutely want to use regular passenger cars, it would be best to include them as a bonus after completing the game.

I use a 360 controller, and I think it might be better to assign the handbrake to the B button (that's how it's done in many racing games).

The lowered price and frequent updates are positive points, but looking at the current state of the game, I get the feeling that it's being developed with very little meaningful feedback from average players. Please strike a good balance between the developer's dedication to gameplay and ease of play.
reviews.developer_response:
Thanks again for your thoughtful and detailed feedback — it really does make a difference during Early Access.

I don’t give these out often, but I’ve sent a Steam Award your way as a small thank you.

Feedback like this genuinely helps shape the future of Off World Racing, so it’s greatly appreciated.
